gloss: seventy percent in bloom; nearly full bloom

definitions.gloss: seventy percent in bloom; nearly full bloom
definitions.explanation: A stage of flowering when approximately 70% of the blossoms have opened. Part of the cherry blossom scale used in weather forecasts and hanami planning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七分咲|ななぶざ}きだ。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are about seventy percent in bloom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週末|こんしゅうまつ}→今週末：30306_konshuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七分咲|ななぶざ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧です。
examples.english: The forecast is for seventy percent bloom this weekend.

examples.japanese: {七分咲|ななぶざ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed cherry blossom viewing under trees that were nearly in full bloom.

notes:
Part of the traditional cherry blossom blooming scale (⟦{開花|かいか}→開花：14525_kaika⟧ stages) used by the Japan Meteorological Agency and in daily conversation during spring. The scale progresses through stages from buds (⟦{蕾|つぼみ}→蕾：04368_tsubomi⟧) to full bloom (⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧) to falling petals (⟦{散|ち}り→散る：02075_chiru⟧{始|はじ}め).

BLOOMING SCALE:
- ⟦{蕾|つぼみ}→蕾：04368_tsubomi⟧: buds
- ⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧{始|はじ}め: beginning to bloom
- {三分咲|さんぶざ}き: 30% bloom
- ⟦{五分咲|ごぶざ}き→五分咲き：18177_gobuzaki⟧: 50% bloom (half bloom)
- {七分咲|ななぶざ}き: 70% bloom
- ⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧: full bloom
- ⟦{散|ち}り→散る：02075_chiru⟧{始|はじ}め: beginning to fall

USAGE:
Many people consider {七分咲|ななぶざ}き to be the most beautiful stage for ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧, as the blossoms are nearly full but the trees still have fresh buds opening.
